candidates.summary: Finish an exposed rival within one magazine. Generated-map placement 1.063 to 1.109 in 128 unseen pairs, 48 campus pairs tied. Docker 300/300.
Prioritize early equipment while free of a pursuer. On 96 unseen generated and campus pairs, local placement gained 0.115. Docker 300/300, p99 1.5 ms.
Forecast visible projectile crossings and sidestep when the mech can improve clearance. Mean placement increased 0.125 across 128 unseen generated and campus pairs. Docker 300/300.
Combine acceleration-aware sidesteps with magazine-aware finishers. Across 256 fresh pairs the combination gained local placement against both parents overall. Docker 300/300, p99 2.2 ms.

Keep firing at a recently wounded opponent during squad pressure. Three paired four-mech panels improved; an independent 24-game squad panel tied. All three agents approved the official experiment. Docker 300/300.

combat.reason: Focuses fire on a recently damaged opponent under squad pressure. Four-mech mean placement improved across 64, 144 and 96 paired games. The 68-game squad comparison gained 0.529 points overall. The 300-tick Docker replay passed.

survival.reason: Circle routing is unchanged. I checked the mixed squad cohorts: -0.250 on 20 pairs and +0.854 on 48. Zone damage rose by about 29 HP per match, while pooled survival and kills rose. Worth measuring in official practice.

validation.reason: On 24 additional full-campus pairs the mean tied at 8.958, with seven improved, twelve tied and five worse. The paired 95% bootstrap interval was -1.04 to +1.04. Prior paired gains justify an official trial; an improved official result is uncertain.

candidates.summary: Use predicted muzzle motion, intercept distance and yaw/pitch spread before withholding gunfire. Corrected the 921409 replay. +0.60 local squad points over 40 fresh pairs, +0.063 over 48 four-mech pairs. Docker 300/300.

combat.reason: The 921409 gun triggers are restored, correcting an archived hit that the previous filter would have removed. Fresh squad panels gained 0.875 over 24 pairs and 0.1875 over 16 independent pairs. Four-mech gained 0.0625 over 48 pairs. All 24 tests and 300 official replay observations passed.

survival.reason: The revision corrects the replay-proven gun trigger suppression while preserving movement and commanded torso aim. Both fresh squad panels and the four-mech panel improved. The intercept remains approximate, but paired gains and the fixed replay warrant an official trial.

validation.reason: Independently confirmed the 921409 muzzle-motion correction and 0.1875 gain on 16 fresh campus pairs. Pooled 40 campus pairs gained 0.600 points per match. Individual regressions and finite spread sampling remain. Approve to measure it officially.

candidates.summary: Briefly prioritize the most recent rear attacker when wounded in squad pressure. Two gains and 34 ties over 36 fresh squad pairs, with most gain from one match. 48 four-mech ties, Docker 300/300.

combat.reason: Owner 24 and independent 12 squad panels each gained on one match and saw no placement regression. All 48 four-mech placements tied. Rare benefit with most of the measured effect from one match; approve a low-confidence official trial.

survival.reason: An independent squad gain replicated the direction with no losses. The brief decaying bias may help wounded mechs under rear pressure. The effect occurred in two local matches and is not an estimate of a stable official lift.

validation.reason: Independent 12 campus pairs yielded one one-place gain and eleven ties; owner 24 yielded an 11-point gain and 23 ties. Consider this a measurable rare event experiment rather than an expected score increase.
